result.summary: Deprecates the `replaceable` parameter in transaction and PSBT creation and modification RPCs (`createrawtransaction`, `fundrawtransaction`, `createpsbt`, `walletcreatefundedpsbt`, `send`, `sendtoaddress`, `sendmany`, `sendall`, `bumpfee`, and `psbtbumpfee`). Passing the parameter now throws an `RPC_METHOD_DEPRECATED` error unless Bitcoin Core is configured with `-deprecatedrpc=bip125`. The PR also relocates BIP 125 documentation comments to `util/rbf.h` and updates functional tests.
result.problem: Because full-RBF has been standard and enabled by default across the network since Bitcoin Core v28, transactions are replaceable regardless of BIP 125 opt-in sequence signalling. Allowing users to explicitly configure opt-in replaceability across ten RPCs is redundant and complicates the RPC interface.
evidence: PR description: 'This builds upon the existing issue of removing the option for users to signal replaceability because fullrbf is the default policy and prevalent in the network (since bitcoin core v28 was released in late 2024) that makes every transaction replaceable by default, making this user option unnecessary.'
Linked issue #32661: 'wallet, node: Redundant opt-in RBF wallet config and RPC parameters'

enables: Complete removal of the `replaceable` RPC argument and associated BIP 125 opt-in sequencing logic in a future major release.

result.scope_notes: Touches ten RPC endpoints across both node and wallet RPC handlers using the standard `-deprecatedrpc=bip125` gate, accompanied by comprehensive functional test updates.
result.changed_since_previous: Moved a BIP 125 sequence number rationale comment from wallet/spend.cpp to util/rbf.h, cleaned up non-replaceable bumpfee tests, and expanded wallet_deprecated_rbf.py coverage.
result.card: Deprecates the `replaceable` argument across transaction and PSBT creation and modification RPCs, requiring `-deprecatedrpc=bip125` to continue passing it. Since Bitcoin Core v28, full-RBF is the default network policy, making BIP 125 opt-in signalling redundant. This resolves #32661 by staging the argument for eventual removal to simplify the wallet RPC interface.

risk.why: External applications or scripts that still explicitly provide the `replaceable` parameter without setting `-deprecatedrpc=bip125` will encounter RPC deprecation errors when creating or bumping transactions.
